articles.title: Stanley Druckenmiller's first X post backs Hyperliquid venture after $23 million indirect investment
articles.snippet: The billionaire investor disclosed an investment in Trade[XYZ] as the platform teams up with the NYSE's parent company. His family office previously reported owning shares in a HYPE-focused treasury company.

articles.title: Polymarket brings ultra-short crypto prediction markets to U.S. platform
articles.snippet: Polymarket’s new Up/Down crypto contracts come as the CFTC renews scrutiny of the prediction market’s compliance with its 2022 U.S. onboarding terms.

articles.title: Walmart, Eli Lilly join growing pushback against OKX–ICE tokenized stock plans
articles.snippet: Five more companies have objected, bringing the total to 38 as a rival Canton venue prepares to launch with an issuer-sponsored stock under the SEC's innovation exemption.

articles.title: Tokenized stock venue on Canton could beat OKX–ICE to first trade under SEC framework
articles.snippet: The venue, called TSV LLC, plans to start trading shares Canton Strategic Holdings shares as early as Monday, using issuer-sponsored tokenization that avoids the 30-day company objection window.
